name: field-game
description: The field_game workspace root: core, worker, app, and checks.

scripts.dev: node tools/dev-prepare.mjs && npm run dev --workspace field-game-app
scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build:wasm && npm run build --workspace field-game-app
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:units && npm run test:tools && npm run check:lexicon
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p app/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
